title: Appendage Blow
description: Your target loses a finger. This hand will suffer a -2 penalty on all checks until appropriate healing spell cast upon the target.

title: Apple Core
description: "...nothing more. Who's your friend?" You utter those words and the first party member to call out a target gets to choose who gets a bonus attack. Apply [[1d10]] damage to that target.

title: Body Blow
description: Your target's lung is slashed. This results in the target being stunned for 2 rounds with a -1 penalty to combat until healed with appropriate healing spell. If this action is impossible due to the nature of the target, then you do standard critical damage +5, instead.

title: Decapitate
description: Your target's head explodes in a shower of blood, bone, and bits. If they have only one head, they are dead. If they have more than one head they lose half their health after damage is applied. You nod at them mockingly.

title: El Ka-Bong
description: Off in the distance you hear lute music. It is quickly getting closer and louder. Out of nowhere comes a lute, smacking the target in the head doing [[1d10]] bludgeoning damage.

title: Eviscerate
description: The entrails of your enemy explode from their body covering anyone within mele distance in gore. This pumps them up... they get +2 on thier next attack. Double the critical hit damage on this target. Wipe the blood from your face and grin.

title: Eye Gouge
description: Your target is "blinded" until the end of its next turn.

title: Feeling the Love
description: You feel the admiration of your party and it fills your heart. Roll a [[1d6]] and add that number in temporary hit points to your character.

title: Forceful Blow
description: Your target is "dazed" until the end of its next turn.

title: Freeze Frame
description: A catchy tune enters your target's mind. They are paralyzed for [[1d4]] rounds as their OCD forces them to sing the entire song in their head. You can hear them humming it, but they are otherwise motionless. Hum the tune you hear to your party.

title: Gaping Wound
description: The target takes ongoing 5 +1/2 your level damage (round up).

title: Good Job, Here's a Treat
description: You regain one spell slot or 2 temporary hit points. Good job!

title: Hamstring
description: You hamstring the target. While they don't fall prone, the target is "slowed" a DC8 DEX ends it.

title: Head Blow
description: The target loses [[1d6]] bludgeoning for a blow to the skull. They are dazed and permanently grant combat advantage to opponents approaching from whichever side was hit. If this action is impossible due to the nature of the target you do standard critical hit damage +10, instead.

title: Inspirational
description: Your hit dazzles your party... but which is the most dazzled party member? Each of them must compliment your hit — choose the best one. They were inspired by you, so they draw a card from the inspiration deck.

title: Inspired
description: That was pretty bad-ass. Draw a card from the inspiration deck — it goes straight into your inventory, to play whenever you like.

title: It's Not You It's Me
description: Your target is "turned" for 1 minute or until attacked. It must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can't willingly move to a space within 30 feet of you. For its Action, it can use only the Dash Action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving.

title: Jazz Hands
description: You distract the target. All characters within mele range of them can move away without an opportunity attack on their next turn.

title: Knee Hit
description: Your target's leg is cut off at the knee, and movement reduced to 1/4 speed. Target will have a permanent limp and -5 movement as an after affect. If this action is impossible due to the nature of the target then you do standard critical damage [[1d8]], instead. You point at your leg and wink at the target.

title: Knockdown
description: You knock the target prone. "Ouch," it thinks, "I am suddenly having a pretty bad day."

title: Knockout Blow
description: You knock the target Unconcious. A DC10 Intelligence check or target taking damage ends.

title: Mighty Blow
description: You do twice the critical hit damage to the target.

title: Need a Hug
description: You get a bonus action to try to grapple your target if you choose to do so.

title: Obliterate
description: The lower torso of the target is severed from the rest of the body... the target can no longer move as it has no means of movement, but it is not prone. Double the critical hit damage. Rejoice in this golrious bloodbath by doing a happy dance to rub it in. This makes the target sad.

title: Opportunity
description: You may take an extra standard action this turn.

title: Parry
description: You gain +2 to all your defenses against attacks from the target until the end of your next turn.

title: Party Animal
description: Your target pulls out a mug of ale to dull the pain and finds themselves intoxicated for the next [[1d4]] rounds..

title: Play Date
description: The party attacks with advantage until the end of the round. If you are the last member of the party in the round, well, better luck next time.

title: Poopy Pants
description: You hit your target hard... real hard. It poops its pants. Your target is stunned until the end of the next round.

title: Pressure Point
description: You got on their nerves, so the target is "weakened." A DC 11 Strength ends it.

title: Puppet Master
description: Your target is charmed. It remains so until it is attacked, you release it, or it makes a DC10 Wisdom saving throw.

title: Restack
description: You roll 2d6 and change the initiative of the target of your choice to [[2d6]]. Do this [[1d6]] times and shout, "Restack, mofo!" each time.

title: See Ya
description: The target moves 50 feet (or until they hit a wall or object) in the direction of your choosing. They take [[1d6]] bludgeoning damage.

title: Shields Up
description: A mysterious force surrounds you. For the next [[1d4]] rounds attacks against you are -2 to hit.

title: Shoulder Blow
description: Your target's arm is severed at the shoulder and is "stunned" for 2 rounds. This results in a permanent -2 to all checks until healed with appropriate healing spell. If this action is impossible due to the nature of the target, you do standard critical hit damage +7, instead.

title: Slow-Mo
description: Your target can only move half its distance and attacks with disadvantage for the next two rounds.

title: Spell Slot Mojo
description: You regain a spell slot or can gift the same to one of your party members.

title: Stay Down
description: You knock the target prone. They fall down go boom.

title: Stop Hitting Yourself
description: Your target attacks itself with its primary weapon.

title: Stunning Blow
description: Your target is "stunned" until the end of its next turn.

title: Total Perspective Vortex
description: For a brief moment your target sees themselves in relation to the totality of the universe. You see a "You Are Here" sign flash above their head... after which they suffer [[2d6]] psychic damage and fall to their knees prone.

title: Turn the Tide
description: You gain combat advantage against all enemies on the battlefield until the end of your next turn.

title: Where Did You Go?
description: The target is blind until the end of the next round

title: Wrist Blow
description: The target's hand is removed at the wrist. There is a 50% chance of either main or off hand... and if main hand, they now roll with disadvantage. Roll a d100 and if [[1d100]] is greater than 50, they lost the hand. If this action is not possible due to the nature of the target, then in addition to standard critical damage, you gain an inspiration point instead.

title: You Have My Attention
description: Your god noticed. They approve and give you +2 on your next attack. Pray to them.

title: You Seem Familiar
description: As you attacked your target, you had a childhood memory randomly pop into your head... a little companion from your past. Poof! Next to you appears that pet until your next long rest. Choose one of the following: cat, dog, pig, rabbit, or chicken. They have 5 HP and are your familiar for the day.

title: You're a Hottie
description: You pop a pipe in the mouth of your target... a novelty pipe. It explodes and does an additional [[1d6]] of damage to the target. You look them in the eye and say, "I learned this from watching you!"

title: Ankle Twist
description: You twist your ankle and have 1/2 movement speed and cannot charge for 1d4+1 rounds. You have to moan as you move.

title: Bad Aim
description: You hit an Ally with a basic attack. They need to do a DC 15 DEX save to see if they can duck out of the way or take the damage.

title: Balance Lost
description: You fall Prone in a wildly dramatic way, muttering "Oh my, I have a case of the vapors" as you fall.

title: Blinded By Your Own Blood
description: You hit yourself in the head causing a minor flesh wound with 4HP damage. You are blinded by blood flowing into your eyes for [[1d4]] rounds.

title: Butterfingers
description: You throw your weapon/implement [[1d4]] squares in a direction based on a [[1d8]] roll (where 1 is north). If you hit a party member, they take [[1d6]] damage.

title: Chicken Hat
description: Out of nowhere, a roast chicken drops on your head like a hat. You are distracted for the next 2 rounds and attack with a -2 penalty. You can't remove it. At the end of the second round the chicken disappears in a puff of feathers.

title: Coping Mechanism
description: That fumble was just too much for you. As a bonus action you pull out a mug of ale and take several big pulls. You are intoxicated for [[1d4]] rounds.

title: Counter Attack
description: The target hits you with a basic attack.

title: Crappy Neighbor
description: "Head's-up!" you yell our as your crappy hit misses its mark and hits one of your party members within mele range of the target. GM chooses the party member with a dice roll. Roll damage on the party member and apply half the damage to them, rounding down.

title: Critical Counter
description: The target critically hits you with a basic attack. Double the normal damage. Ouch.

title: Dislocation
description: A forceful pop in your shoulder is heard as your arm goes limp. The arm you used to make the attack is incapacitated for 1d4 + 6 rounds.

title: Doesn't Keep Going and Going
description: An item you carry with a buff or magical effect on it flickers out like a dying candle. You can not use the item until after your next long rest.

title: Done Broke it
description: Your Weapon/Implement is broken. You mark it as so and swap it out or use it with -5 and disadvantage. You will have to figure out if it can be repaired.

title: Double Trouble
description: Roll the damage from the weapon or spell you were using on yourself... twice. Each time you must say out loud, "Shame on me!" Your target mocks you as you do so.

title: Embarassed
description: You recieve a -2 penalty to attack rolls against target until you successfully hit target with an attack.

title: Fatigued
description: You are dazed until end of your next turn.

title: Fifty-Fifty
description: You feeling lucky? How lucky? Take [[1d10]] damage or roll 1d20 and hope for the best. If you get 1-10, you roll damage on yourself. If you get 11-20, your fumble becomes a hit and you roll damage on your target. Choose wisely.

title: Floor is Lava
description: You embarrased your god. In turn, they turned the 5 foot square on which you stand to lava for this turn. You take [[1d10]] fire damage.

title: Friendly Fire
description: You critically hit an ally with a basic attack. Apply half the damage to them and half the damage to yourself. When you round, they get the brunt of it.

title: Gaseous Maximus
description: Something isn't sitting right in your digestive system and you find yourself incredibly flatulent. Anyone within 10 feet of you is poisoned for [[1D4]] rounds.

title: Generous
description: You let the team down. Make ammends by giving them an item from your inventory. They must accept it. You can't attack again until you complete this task. You may have something they've always wanted... or perhaps they like shiny objects.

title: God Empathy
description: This is a fumble, right? Well, your god feels so bad for you that they roll back time and allow you to re-roll. You lucky duck!

title: Ground Zero
description: You're not sure what happened, but your spell blew up in your face. You take the damage + 6. If you did not cast a spell, just take [[1d10]] damage.

title: Health
description: Choose two party members and steal a bit of their health. They each take 1 HP damage while you gain 2 HP of temporary hit points. Creep.

title: I Need a Doctor
description: You messed up bad. Real bad. Your insides suddenly burst out of your body and become your outsides. You lose half of your hit points each round for 1D4 rounds as you desperatelty try to stuff them back in. Each round do a DC17 Dexterity Saving Throw to end the cycle. You can't be healed until the cycle ends. Sucks to be you.

title: It's Not Me It's You
description: Choose a party member. Attack that party member 2 times with a weapon of your choosing. Now is not the time to score big hits. Sleep with one eye open tonight.

title: Knee Pop
description: Your knee hyperextends awkwardly. You have 1/4 movement speed and cannot charge for [[1d4+6]] rounds.

title: Life Force
description: Every party member donates 2 HP to your target. You donate 4 HP.

title: Lit Up
description: Lightening strikes you, as if punishing you for such a crappy roll. Take 1d6 lightening damage.

title: Love is in the Air
description: You feel the love, and bee-line to the closest party member for a mega-hug. They are grappled until they break your grapple. You can not choose to let go... it is love afterall. If your target was within mele and you moved away, they do get an opportunity attack.

title: Madvantage
description: You really anger your target. How dare you make such a feeble attempt against their clear badassery. They roll with advantage for the next [[1d4]] rounds.

title: McGyver Time
description: Your weapon is jacked. You must spend your next action fixing it with found objects around you.

title: Overextended
description: You are stunned until the end of your next turn.

title: Pulled Muscle
description: You are weakened until end of your next turn.

title: Ranger Danger
description: Your attack confuses your party and any rangers attack you, by accident, with disadvantage. If you are a ranger, you attack yourself, foolishly, with advantage.

title: Saturday Night Fever
description: The power of dance compells you! You dance uncontrollably until the end of the next round and suffer 1 level of exhaustion.

title: Shut Up
description: You can not speak until the end of combat. Your party members are likely delighted by this.

title: Spell Backlash
description: Your spell feeds back to you, doing its damage and effects on yourself. If you didn't cast a spell, you got lucky.

title: Staggering in Pain
description: Your opponent parries your awkward attack that causes you to hit yourself in the groin. You have 1/2 movement and -4 to all actions for [[1d6+4]] rounds. Your eyes water, so you are blind until the end of your next turn.

title: Stinky Pete
description: It has been a while since you've bathed... and that last attack really worked up a sweat. You stink. Your party members must only refer to you as "Stinky Pete" until your next long rest, which must include bathing.

title: Suicide Strike
description: You hit yourself with same attack you fumbled with, receiving all negative conditions and effects of the attack. Dummy.

title: That Ain't Booze
description: You reach for your flask to calm your nerves, but you accidentally grab poison. You are poisoned for [[1d10]] rounds or until someone addresses the medical issue.

title: Too Many Tacos
description: You suddenly feel as if you overdid it at lunch and immediately gain the weight of 1000 tacos. You are encumbered for [[1d4]] rounds.

title: Tough Situation
description: Take [[1d8]] damage or deal [[1d10]] damage to one of the other party members. Your choice. Have fun with it.

title: Turnabout
description: Wow, I mean, what were you thinking? This didn't work out quite like you'd planned, and your target rolls damage on you instead.

title: Wrong Strap
description: In an embarrasing move, you cut loose part of your armor and receive a -5 penalty until armor is fixed. Fixing the armor will require [[1d3]] rounds of performing no other action. Good luck with that.

title: Your Bad Side
description: A copy of you appears next to you. They are filled with self-hate, embarrased by your fumble. They steal 5 HP from you, and take their turn right before you in each round until dead. Consider therapy.
